purpose: Non-mutating, claim-level source locks for the approved geography pilot. This is not a CKL expansion candidate queue and authorizes no production write.

source_policy.openbible_boundary: OpenBible is used only for passage-indexed entity identity and provenance. It is never the sole support for territory, route, physical-setting, or political claims.
source_policy.copyright_boundary: Records store concise factual assertions and locators, not copied source prose.
